scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"

scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web

scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm start --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run build && npm run smoke --prefix desktop
